+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+"""<tool-name> — the dry-run shape holds without a model.
+
+    python3 tests/test_template.py
+
+Every step in machine/run.py STEPS has a prompt in prompts/, and each prompt
+asks only for the fields run.py supplies — the two things a `--dry-run` needs
+from a fresh copy. Nothing is run, written or spent.
+"""
+import ast
+import sys
+import unittest
+from pathlib import Path
+
+HERE = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
+TOOL = HERE.parent
+REPO = next(d for d in TOOL.parents if (d / "components").is_dir() and (d / "brands").is_dir())
+sys.path.insert(0, str(REPO / "components" / "run-kit"))
+from run_kit import prompts as P          # noqa: E402
+
+# The fields machine/run.py passes to each step's chain.run(...)
+SUPPLIED = {"stage1": {"source"}, "stage2": {"record"}}
+
+
+def steps():
+    tree = ast.parse((TOOL / "machine" / "run.py").read_text())
+    for node in tree.body:
+        if isinstance(node, ast.Assign) and any(getattr(t, "id", None) == "STEPS" for t in node.targets):
+            return ast.literal_eval(node.value)
+    raise AssertionError("machine/run.py declares no STEPS")
+
+
+class DryRunShape(unittest.TestCase):
+    def test_every_step_has_a_prompt(self):
+        for s in steps():
+            self.assertTrue(P.latest(TOOL / "prompts", s["key"]).is_file(), s["key"])
+
+    def test_every_prompt_asks_only_for_supplied_fields(self):
+        for s in steps():
+            template = P.latest(TOOL / "prompts", s["key"]).read_text()
+            self.assertEqual(set(P.wanted(template)) - SUPPLIED.get(s["key"], set()), set(), s["key"])
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    unittest.main(verbosity=1)

+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+"""A copy of this template dry-runs out of the box (run-kit review task 4).
+
+The copy is made into a throwaway workspace that holds `brands/` and the two
+components the template imports (run-kit, marketing-chain-checks) as
+symlinks to the real ones — exactly what a fresh copy inside this workspace
+sees, without the test writing anything outside its temp folder.
+
+    python3 tests/test_dry_run.py
+"""
+import os
+import shutil
+import subprocess
+import sys
+import tempfile
+import unittest
+from pathlib import Path
+
+HERE = Path(__file__).resolve().parent          # <copy>/tests
+TEMPLATE = HERE.parent                          # the copied tool folder
+REAL = TEMPLATE.parent                          # components/run-kit (at authoring time)
+
+
+class DryRunOutOfTheBox(unittest.TestCase):
+    def setUp(self):
+        self.tmp = tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix="run-kit-template-")
+
+    def tearDown(self):
+        shutil.rmtree(self.tmp, ignore_errors=True)
+
+    def test_a_copy_dry_runs_with_no_authoring(self):
+        ws = Path(self.tmp) / "ws"
+        (ws / "brands").mkdir(parents=True)
+        (ws / "components").mkdir()
+        for dep in ("run-kit", "marketing-chain-checks"):
+            target = REAL.parent / dep
+            self.assertTrue(target.is_dir(), f"the real {dep} is not beside this template")
+            os.symlink(str(target), str(ws / "components" / dep))
+        tool = ws / "components" / "<tool-name>"
+        shutil.copytree(TEMPLATE, tool, ignore=shutil.ignore_patterns("tests", "__pycache__"))
+        src = ws / "source.md"
+        src.write_text("something to read\n")
+        env = dict(os.environ, AI_WORKSPACE=str(ws))
+        r = subprocess.run(
+            [sys.executable, str(tool / "machine" / "run.py"), str(src),
+             "--brand", "somebrand", "--label", "dry-check", "--dry-run"],
+            env=env, stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE,
+            universal_newlines=True)
+        self.assertEqual(r.returncode, 0, r.stdout + r.stderr)
+        self.assertIn("dry", r.stdout)
+        self.assertTrue((ws / "runs" / "<tool-name>" / "somebrand" / "dry-check").is_dir(),
+                        "the dry run's out folder")
+        self.assertEqual(r.stdout.count("~~"), 2, "both stages resolved and dried")
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    unittest.main(verbosity=2)
